full_judgment: 3. Respondent No. 1, Nek Parvin Islam, as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 88 of 1992 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, First Court, Dhaka (now Joint District Judge) for declaration of title in 2½ kathas of land described in schedule-'Ka' to the plaint (hereinafter referred to as the suit land) and for recovery of khas possession of the flat described in schedule-'Gha' to the plaint out of 3(three) storied building from added defendant Nos. 9-11 and for cancellation of kabala No. 11689 dated 24.09.1977 of Dhaka Sadar Sub-Registrar's Office as described in schedule-'Kha' to the plaint allegedly executed by her in favour of her father, A.K.M. Abdullah (since deceased) and her step mother, Begum Sufia Abdullah who were impleaded in the suit as defendant Nos. 1 and 3 respectively as void, illegal, collusive and inoperative.
